sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law / Civil Law / Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None currently in force: Vanuatu has no active bilateral investment treaty or double tax agreement
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — trade and economic cooperation agreement
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement — sub-regional trade framework
WTO Membership — Vanuatu has been a WTO Member since 24 August 2012

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017, including provisions requiring the beneficial ownership register to be filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017, as amended, together with the Financial Transactions Reporting Regulations and VFSC AML/CFT Guidance Notes; Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 287] for confiscation-related frameworks; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Compliance Rules issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport (or other recognized government-issued photographic ID) of each proposed shareholder, UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority in the individual's country of origin or residence; notarized by a licensed notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a party to the 1961 Hague Convention) OR Consular Legalization by a Vanuatu diplomatic or consular post for issuances from non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential or business address (utility bill, bank statement, or tax record) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed financial institution, or government tax authority in the country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference / banker's good-standing letter from an existing financial institution for each proposed UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization where the bank reference is required to be notarized by the receiving registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent to act as director and shareholder (signed and witnessed by a licensed notary or an independent witness acceptable to the VFSC)
Certificate of good standing / extract of registry for any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or companies registrar in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Vanuatu licensed registered agent or a lawful attorney for pre-incorporation filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed incorporator or authorized corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent to use the registered office / registered agent address form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required when the registered agent itself physically executes the consent; foreign-proofing may still require apostille if executed outside Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestically maintained Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit watch list. Politically Exposed Person screening and adverse-media checks are mandatory under VFSC AML/CFT guidance. A risk-based enhanced due diligence protocol is required whenever a PEP, family member, close associate, sanctioned individual, or high-risk jurisdiction exposure is identified. The standard threshold for UBO identification is 25% ownership or control, and all non-face-to-face applicants must obtain a certified beneficial ownership declaration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry Online Filing Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be in Latin script using the English or French alphabet; Bislama or customary names are permitted only if rendered in Latin characters. The proposed name must be distinguishable from existing registered names, reserved names, trademarks, and protected government identifiers. Vanuatu International Companies are required to include the suffix Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, or the relevant abbreviation such as Ltd, Corp, or Inc; the Foreign Investment Registration Act may separately govern trading names where a foreign-owned entity is physically conducting business in Vanuatu.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may request an administrative review by written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission within 14 business days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the full proposed name, the statutory or documentary grounds for reversal, evidence of distinctiveness, and, where applicable, the prior ministerial or supervisory consent required for sensitive tokens. The VFSC Registrar is required to respond in writing within a further 14 business days. If the administrative appeal is unsuccessful, the applicant may apply for judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Vanuatu (Amendment) Rules and general administrative law principles. No extended name-reservation window is available following rejection; a fresh filing must be made if the applicant wishes to pursue a modified name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permissible as a substitute for the statutory registered office. Every Vanuatu International Company must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. For a deep-sea RoRo vessel operator with no physical presence onshore, a licensed registered agent's office satisfies the statutory physical registered-office requirement. A virtual back-office or shared service arrangement may be used for internal administration and bookkeeping only, but it cannot serve as the registered office for purposes of service of process or regulatory correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: estimated 10–15% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection or registered-office verification for a non-regulated low-risk shipping holding and operating vehicle, increasing to above 40% if the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit or VFSC receives an adverse AML/CFT filing, a suspicious transaction report, or a cross-border regulatory inquiry.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (International Companies Registry)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (International Companies Registry)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service — first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu licensed registered agent / corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for VFSC-licensed registered agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and/or consular legalization of passport, address, and corporate good-standing documents per natural-person UBO and director
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and authentication/legalization authority in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff and prevailing consular fee benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and domestic sanctions screening plus AML/CFT compliance risk assessment package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu licensed registered agent / compliance due diligence provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for multi-jurisdiction sanctions and PEP screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO register preparation, beneficial ownership declaration, and VFSC filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee plus professional compliance service fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure international courier for original signed documents, apostilled documents, and post-incorporation statutory kit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International express courier service (e.g., DHL, FedEx)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing courier rate for Vanuatu-bound services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Sections 3, 7, 9, 11, 12, 15 and 18); International Companies (Registration) Regulations; Companies (Amendment) Act 2012
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-01) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and registered office consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; the Company may be incorporated with a nominal share capital denominated in any convertible currency; no escrow, deposit or bank confirmation is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers’ share subscriptions are accepted and the initial directors named in the application be appointed as the first board; the registered office of the Company shall be established at the address maintained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent; the directors be appointed as President, Secretary and Treasurer respectively; the corporate bank account signatories be designated by the board; all pre-incorporation contracts be ratified; and the directors are authorized to execute all documents, affix the common seal, appoint agents, and take all steps necessary to secure all maritime and operational licences for the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registry of International Companies (online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company name variants via the VFSC approved registered agent using Form IC-00; the Registry conducts a name availability and restricted word search; upon clearance, the name is reserved for 30 days pending formal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association draft
Due diligence information on subscribers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is refused, submit alternative variants or a written appeal to the VFSC Registry; resubmission is processed within one working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registry of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation application Form IC-01 through the licensed registered agent, including executed Memorandum and Articles, subscriber statements, director consents, and registered office consent. Pay the applicable government fee by wire transfer or bank deposit to the VFSC collection account.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered agent and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or return, correct the identified deficiency and resubmit via the registered agent within 10 working days; late correction requires a fresh application and new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registry of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns the Company Identification Number; the registered agent obtains the certified copy and registers the company in the VFSC public database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate issuance is delayed, the registered agent may submit a formal follow-up request or escalation to the Registry Director; expedited issuance available upon payment of expedite fee where legally permitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Constitution of First Board and Adoption of Governance Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board of Directors and VFSC-registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the written first board resolution, approve the share issue and officer appointments, ratify the registered office arrangement, designate the bank signatories, and authorize the opening of corporate bank accounts.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a quorum or notice defect is identified, reconvene the board after proper written notice and adopt a ratification resolution curing the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registry File Extraction and Corporate KYC Packing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request official corporate extracts, Certificate of Good Standing, and certified true copies of constitutional documents; assemble a complete corporate KYC pack for banking, maritime authorities and counterparties.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association certified copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If extracts contain discrepancies, file a correction request with supporting corporate records; VFSC shall issue corrected extracts upon verification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Services Authority (VMSA) - Maritime Safety Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Ship Registration Certificate and Safety Management Certificate (International Safety Management Code)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration category for offshore Ro-Ro vessel operations; Full EIA report required only for port-related shore-side facilities, jetties or terminals
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with MARPOL Annex I through VI; no oil, oily mixture, sewage, garbage or VOC discharge within prohibited zones; ballast water management in accordance with VMSA and IMO BWM Convention standards

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for vessels and any shore office, structural load inspection for terminals/facilities used, workplace health and safety clearance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour, and vessel radio/safety equipment survey clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), the unified Department of Customs and Inland Revenue within the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official registration and e-services portal: https://customs.gov.vu. Licensing of International Companies is administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu levies no income tax, capital gains tax, or wealth tax on any person, so no statutory income-tax TIN is issued. A foreign entity that imports, supplies, or intends to supply taxable goods or services in Vanuatu must register for VAT with the VRC by submitting the official VAT Registration Application Form together with certified constitutional documents, proof of local registered address, list of directors and principal officers, bank references, and a projected turnover declaration. Upon approval, the VRC issues a VAT Registration Number. An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes and duties and is prohibited from trading with Vanuatu residents; therefore it does not complete this SOP, and its VFSC company registration number serves as the sole regulatory identifier.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, fiscal-transparent, or hybrid-mismatch elections exist under Vanuatu law because no income-tax regime is in force. Available statutory elections are limited to: (i) voluntary VAT registration under section 7 of the VAT Act No. 16 of 1998 for suppliers whose taxable turnover is below the VT 2,000,000 compulsory threshold; and (ii) conversion or re-domiciliation of an International Company as an onshore company under the Companies Act, which terminates the IC's blanket tax exemption and subjects the entity to local VAT and duties on Vanuatu-source activities. An IC may also elect, in exceptional circumstances, to hold a VAT registration solely to claim zero-rating on eligible export services, although such registration is not generally required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 2,000,000 (approximately USD 16,700) of taxable supplies per annum; registration is mandatory as soon as taxable turnover for any 12-month period has exceeded, or is reasonably expected to exceed, this amount pursuant to sections 6 and 7 of the VAT Act No. 16 of 1998.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None in force. Vanuatu has not implemented real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, continuous transaction controls, or digital stamping. Registered taxpayers may issue paper or electronic VAT invoices, provided the invoice contains the prescribed particulars, including serial number, supplier VAT registration number, customer details, description of supply, taxable consideration, and VAT amount at the applicable rate. Invoices must be retained for VRC audit inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods qualify for the 0% rate where the goods are physically removed from Vanuatu within the prescribed period and the exporter retains corroborative customs evidence. Services, including deep-sea Ro-Ro vehicle transport between ports located entirely outside Vanuatu, qualify for zero-rating where the supplier belongs in Vanuatu for VAT purposes and the recipient belongs in a foreign country, provided the services are not effectively used or consumed in Vanuatu. Incidental port handling, stevedoring, or terminal charges physically performed within Vanuatu waters or terminals remain standard-rated unless a specific statutory zero-rating or exemption applies. The taxpayer bears the burden of proving physical removal or foreign consumption; failure to retain the statutory export evidence invalidates the 0% rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration approved by Vanuatu Customs and validated at the port of departure
Bill of Lading (Ocean) evidencing carriage from a non-Vanuatu loading port to a non-Vanuatu discharge port
Inward Remittance Certificate (or SWIFT MT103 credit advice) proving receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list encoding the overseas consignee
Vessel departure certificate or cargo manifest countersigned by the shipping agent
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating claims attract retrospective clawback of any input VAT recovered, default interest, and a civil penalty of 5% per month on the unpaid VAT. Criminal conviction for VAT evasion carries a fine of up to VT 500,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years under the VAT Act. Knowingly false export declarations additionally trigger monetary penalties, forfeiture, and prosecution under the Customs Act. The VRC may reopen and reassess transactions for up to 7 years in cases of wilful default or fraud. Although Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control statute, failure to evidence receipt of export proceeds within the 180-day standard voids the zero-rating election and re-characterises the supply as taxable, exposing the taxpayer to full VAT clawback, penalties, and cancellation of the IC tax exemption if the entity has engaged in unauthorised local trade.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); exchange control is administered by RBV under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 68] through licensed authorised dealer banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, and the Vatu (VUV) is a free-floating currency with full current-account convertibility. Non-resident International Companies may freely receive charter-party earnings, capital contributions and shareholder loans in USD, AUD, EUR or VUV without prior RBV exchange-control approval, subject only to documentary verification by the authorised dealer bank. Repatriation of profits, dividends and capital is unencumbered by any exchange-allocation mechanism, dividend-blocking rule or quantifiable quota; administration is exercised through balance-of-payments reporting by the receiving bank. Capital-account transactions of a resident character, including resident outward investment and resident foreign-currency borrowing, remain notifiable to the RBV and may require prior approval where the counterparty is a Vanuatu resident or the transaction utilises domestic credit. The absence of sub-jurisdictional fiscal or monetary distinctions in Vanuatu means a single national regime applies to all VU_IC accounts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender ratio, compulsory VUV conversion, or prescribed repatriation timeline for Ro-Ro vessel freight and charter proceeds. Export receipts must, however, be routed through a Vanuatu licensed authorised dealer bank, recorded for balance-of-payments purposes, and be traceable to the underlying ISIC 5012 activity. Foreign-currency retention on the operating account is expressly permitted. The supporting documentary baseline for each receipt is the charter party, the signed freight invoice or bill of lading, and the identifying vessel name and IMO number; retained funds may be deployed directly for bunkering, port disbursement, crew wages, and LC cover without separate surrender approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account with sub-ordinated Capital Escrow Account
USD Operating Account and VUV Local Settlement Account
Capital Escrow Account and Trade Finance Settlement Account
VUV Local Operating Account (port-agent and payroll payments)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: LOW. Vanuatu maintains no offshore EMI licensing framework, and the Banking Act [Cap. 62] together with the AML/CFT Act 2020 requires any payment-service provider holding customer money for a VU_IC to hold a VFSC banking or financial-dealer licence. Offshore digital EMIs and BaaS aggregators (including Airwallex-class platforms) generally decline Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies as a direct consequence of the jurisdiction's FATF increased-monitoring status (from June 2024) and the lack of an EMI passporting arrangement. EMIs may at most be used as supplemental pay-in/pay-out gateways where a licensed domestic bank sponsors and retains settlement finality; all primary liquidity rails must terminate at a Vanuatu licensed authorised dealer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no statutory obligation under Vanuatu law for directors to appear physically before the bank. The AML/CFT Act 2020 and VFSC guidance permit non-face-to-face customer due diligence where risk-based enhancements are satisfied; the market standard is certified true copies of directors' passports, a professional referral from a VFSC-licensed registered agent, and a live video interview (Designated Person Protocol) conducted by the bank's compliance officer. Local substance is strongly accelerative for shipping entities: a dedicated Port Vila office, local board minutes evidencing decisions, and employee records of the operations director materially increase the probability of same-week account approval and corresponding-bank clearing limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction risk arising from Vanuatu's FATF 'jurisdictions under increased monitoring' listing (June 2024), triggering enhanced screening by correspondent banks on all MT103 and SWIFT LC messages routed through USD clearing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month cash-flow forecast; VFSC beneficial-ownership register extract; Economic Substance Act 2020 filing receipt; audited financial statements for the VU_IC; Sanctions/PEP screening attestation; certified certificate of incorporation with express confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 'Brass-plate' substance red flag where the ISIC 5012 Ro-Ro business is managed entirely offshore without demonstrable CIGA activity in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for a physical Port Vila office; payroll and employment contracts for local operations personnel; board minutes of meetings held in Vanuatu; executed ship-management agreement; annual economic substance return filed with VFSC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth ambiguity on capital escrow funding where the origin is charter-party profits or intra-group shareholder cash rather than a single identifiable sale.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed charter parties; freight invoices and broker settlement advices; vessel registry certificate with IMO number; P&I insurance certificate; twelve-month bank statements of the originating operating account; group corporate structure chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legacy International Companies Act concerns regarding bearer shares, nominee shareholders, and opaque beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current shareholder register naming all ultimate beneficial owners; registered-agent confirmation from the licensed Vanuatu corporate services provider; statutory declaration that bearer shares were either cancelled or never issued; disclosure of any nominee arrangements to the bank's AML officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are executed by SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for high-value treasury transfers) from the parent shipowner to the VU_IC USD Operational or Capital Escrow Account at a licensed authorised dealer. The ISO 20022 purpose code must be 'EQTY' for paid-up equity with narrative 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - VU_IC OCEAN RORO (ISIC 5012)'; shareholder loans use purpose code 'LOAN' with reference to the executed intercompany loan agreement. The remitting bank must receive a board resolution authorising the escrow allocation, the executed share subscription instrument, the VFSC Foreign Investment approval (where the shareholder is a non-citizen), and the current beneficial-ownership extract. USD routing is performed through the bank's US correspondent leg; field 71A (details of charges) should elect OUR or SHA to ensure full-value arrival, and the receiving bank must tag the credit as non-resident IC capital under its exchange-control reporting obligation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The designated outgoing rails are Swift_LC and Wire_Transfer. Bunker supply payments are effected by MT103 directly to the supplier or via the mandated bunker trader under the bunker supply agreement. Port disbursement accounts are funded by MT103 to the ship agent with the PDA schedule attached; LC settlements, including MT700 issuance, MT742 reimbursement claims and MT202 cover, are processed under ICC UCP 600 and ISBP 745 for the acquisition of vessels, shipyard instalments and major equipment. Charter hire payments, crew payroll and towage fees are cleared by MT103 via the SWIFT GPI network; all VUV-denominated local payments settle through the RBV-operated national payment clearing system. Standby LCs (MT760) are recommended as performance security for charterers and port authorities, with the VU_IC IC corporate guarantee as backstop.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV outright FX forward contracts through ANZ or BSP authorised-dealer desks (tenors up to 12 months) supported by genuine trade or operational exposure
AUD/USD and EUR/USD Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) booked offshore to hedge crew-wage and European port-cost exposures where the VUV/USD forward market is illiquid
Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD and USD/EUR) matched to the tenor of newbuilding instalments or ship-financing facilities, subject to authorised-dealer approval
Structural NAV hedge via USD-functional-currency invoicing for Ro-Ro freight, bunker and charter-hire cash flows, eliminating the need for spot conversion at the operating level

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (International Companies Act Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; payment must be made on or before the anniversary date each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a penalty (generally 10% per month or part month of the unpaid annual fee). Continued default for six consecutive months may lead to administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return for Shipping Activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Economic Substance Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of each financial period (financial year).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure or continued non-filing may result in a written non-compliance notice, monetary penalty, registration suspension, loss of tax-exempt status, and eventual strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies to Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act Cap. 222. A compulsory independent audit may arise only if the company becomes licensed under a separate financial services law, is required by a lending or flagging institution, or is ordered to audit by special resolution of members.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies must maintain sufficient accounting records to permit the registered agent and VFSC to understand transactions. No mandatory IFRS or Local GAAP is statutorily imposed; IFRS is customary when financial statements are prepared for shipping finance, flag administration, or commercial counterparties.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must file with its registered agent an up-to-date beneficial ownership schedule at incorporation and on every change of ownership or transfer of shares. The agent issues an annual confirmation form which the directors/members must acknowledge before the anniversary renewal; this confirmation remains private to the agent and does not constitute a public UBO filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$750 – US$1,800 per year, depending on agent and service scope, inclusive of registered office and statutory renewal handling.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; if an audit is requested by lenders, shareholders, or flag-state authorities, a typical certified audit fee ranges from US$2,000 – US$6,000 for a RoRo ship-owning vehicle.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Companies hold statutory tax-exempt status)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective taxation: exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax; international Ro-Ro freight revenue falls outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT (12.5%); no payroll tax, social security levy, or vessel property tax applies

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return (IC Form AR-1) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online compliance portal (www.vfsc.vu)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one (1) calendar month following each anniversary of incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, VFSC registration number, and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the IC's status as a tax-exempt International Company; no foreign tax identification number is required

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address maintained in Vanuatu through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the registered agent's street address must be stated

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the licensed registered agent confirming statutory good standing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent files on behalf of non-resident owners; keep agent fees current to avoid strike-off

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Directors and Beneficial Owners Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors, officers, shareholders, and beneficial owners kept at the registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee or corporate shareholders must be disclosed to the agent; the register is confidential but accessible to VFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit under AML law

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC conducted a 'relevant activity' during the year; shipping / maritime transport (ISIC 5012 Ro-Ro) qualifies and requires substance disclosures
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If vessel chartering, freight contracting, or cargo administration is managed from abroad, state the foreign jurisdiction explicitly to mitigate CFC, PE, and GAAR exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Electronic signature of a director, company secretary, or the registered agent certifying accuracy
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may sign digitally; the agent countersigns to certify completion of AML beneficial-ownership verification

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of VT 25,000–50,000 per return; default beyond six months triggers VFSC strike-off, automatic dissolution, and restoration costs charged to directors; no CIT-related late penalty exists because no income tax return is imposed

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive OECD-pattern DTA in force; sectoral shipping agreements and tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist. To support foreign tax credit or CFC defenses abroad, the beneficial owner must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency / Non-Resident Status issued by the VFSC (via the registered agent; approximate fee VT 20,000), confirming that the IC is not tax resident in Vanuatu and is exempt from local income tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory / 0% effective treaty rate; Interest: 0% statutory / 0% effective treaty rate (domestic withholding is already nil; no treaty reduction required)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No transfer pricing legislation or documentation thresholds exist in Vanuatu (VUV-denominated thresholds: N/A); the compliance burden is limited to the annual economic substance declaration rather than arm's-length transfer pricing files
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Act 2022 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022 apply to ICs carrying on 'relevant activities', including shipping and maritime transport (ISIC 5012). A Ro-Ro car-carrier IC must demonstrate: (a) direction and management in Vanuatu; (b) adequate physical premises, full-time employees, and operating expenditure; and (c) performance of core income-generating activities (vessel chartering, freight contracting, cargo administration, invoicing) in Vanuatu. Annual substance declarations are filed with the VFSC; non-compliance attracts financial penalties and deregistration

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company as a bare booking vehicle for Ro-Ro charter income while actual management, contracting, and vessel operations are directed from a high-tax jurisdiction, with zero substance in Vanuatu (CFC/GAAR abuse)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: penalties for false declarations up to VT 10,000,000 and VFSC strike-off; foreign jurisdiction: re-assessment of concealed profits, interest, and penalties up to 100–200% of the tax evaded under CFC and general anti-avoidance rules
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally liable for the company's foreign tax debts; travel bans, mutual-assistance asset-freeze orders, and confiscation orders may issue; egregious cases carry extradition and imprisonment for tax fraud in the home jurisdiction

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining registration while conducting a relevant activity (ship management, chartering, crew payroll, freight billing) without any physical presence, employees, or management meetings in Vanuatu, and failing the annual economic substance declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to VT 10,000,000 under the Economic Substance Act 2022; VFSC deregistration and automatic dissolution; adverse information exchange to foreign tax authorities under CRS and exchange-of-information on request mechanisms
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined up to VT 2,000,000; disqualification orders, personal liability for restoration costs and third-party claims; foreign tax authorities may pierce the corporate veil and impose personal tax penalties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing beneficial ownership through nominee shareholders, undisclosed trusts, or bearer-like arrangements while processing Ro-Ro freight payments and letter-of-credit settlements through Vanuatu accounts, breaching the Vanuatu Financial Market Supervision Act (VFMSA) 2023 and FATF standards
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to VT 100,000,000; freezing and confiscation of assets; VFSC deregistration; bank de-risking and termination of correspondent banking relationships
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 12 years for money laundering; confiscation of personal assets; travel bans; mandatory disqualification from acting as a director; extradition risk under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent or failure to file the annual return and economic substance declaration for more than six months while continuing to charter vessels commercially
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off, late filing surcharges up to VT 100,000, automatic dissolution, and loss of legal capacity to sue or defend claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for restoration costs and creditors' claims arising during the default period; further contempt sanctions and prohibition from acting as directors in Vanuatu may apply
